payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Move the source mug to the right of the headphones.
outcome.target: The mug present in the source image, moved so it is positioned to the right of the headphones. A newly introduced or duplicated mug on the right does not fulfill the request unless evidence establishes it is the source mug.
outcome.reference: Use the source and edited images to assess the source mug's identity, correspondence, and position relative to the headphones. Do not assume that a mug appearing on the right is the source mug.

check.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what evidence shows whether the source mug itself moved to the right relative to the headphones?
check.complete_when: The source mug is identifiable in the edited image and is positioned to the right of the headphones.
check.partial_when: Evidence supports that the source mug itself moved toward the right relative to the headphones, but it is not clearly positioned to their right. Do not count a separate or duplicated right-side mug as progress.
check.absent_when: There is no evidence that the source mug moved toward the right relative to the headphones. The source mug's disappearance, an unidentifiable replacement, or a separate mug appearing on the right alone does not establish movement or prove that no movement occurred.
check.unknown_when: Visual evidence is genuinely insufficient to judge whether the source mug moved toward or to the right of the headphones, even after considering available identity, correspondence, and positional evidence.

dependencies.evidence: The source has one light-blue mug left of the black headphones. In the edited image, the headphones remain recognizable near the center, and a mug is now to their right; however, that right-hand mug is white, unlike the source mug. A light-blue blurred shape remains on the left, while another white mug appears left of the headphones, so the source mug’s correspondence and movement are uncertain; the right-side mug alone does not establish that the source mug was moved.
